title: Earlier weatherman burned by tall white suits at Range Four
place_text: Range Four, Indian Springs Valley; Nellis hospital, Nevada

tellings.quote: and the suit and his shoulder almost touched one of the shoes. And I saw his x-rays and pictures.

plain: In 1965 a military weatherman at Range Four, a test range in the Indian Springs Valley of Nevada, was burned when his shoulder came close to one of the beings Charles Hall calls the Tall Whites, very tall pale beings in suits. Hall, who says he later worked as a weatherman there himself and spent three years among these beings, says he saw the man's x-rays and photographs at the hospital at Nellis, an Air Force base in Nevada, which, if true, would mean the beings could physically harm people.
